title: Rob Lake Magic with Special Guests The Muppets on Broadway #themuppet...
transcript: Putting The Muppets on a Broadway marquee is a surefire way to cause intrigue, but all things considered, this is a pretty standard magic show. Illusionist Rob Lake performs a healthy mix of big, flashy illusions and some smaller, close-up magic. I found the latter more captivating due to the audience involvement and the usage of live projections so everyone could see — as Rob says, “just like a Jamie Lloyd show.” Now, regarding The Muppets, they're present. They have a few little comedic scenes, but otherwise they're not heavily involved — I think it's more of a marketing tactic than anything else since The Muppets are way more of a household name than Rob Lake. But still, Rob holds his own and the show is not a bad way to spend 80 minutes, especially if you're looking for a family-friendly experience. With that, another Playbill for my collection.
